summary:
Results-driven Senior Android Software Developer with 9+ years of expertise in native and cross-platform mobile application development. Proven track record of delivering high-performance, secure mobile solutions in fintech and enterprise systems. Core competencies include:

• Native Android Development: Expert in Java and Kotlin, Android SDK, Material Design, Jetpack Components
• Cross-Platform Development: Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android, BLoC pattern, state management
• Mobile Architecture: MVVM, Clean Architecture, Repository Pattern, Dependency Injection
• Payment Systems: PCI-DSS compliant mobile payment solutions, MPOS, TapOnPhone, SoftPOS
• Security & Compliance: Secure payment processing, encryption, biometric authentication
• Performance Optimization: Memory management, battery optimization, app size reduction
• Technical Leadership: Led and mentored mobile development teams, driving innovation and best practices

Key Achievements:
• Developed MPOS applications processing $50M+ monthly transactions with 99.99% uptime
• Implemented PCI-DSS compliant payment solutions for international banks
• Led development of merchant platform applications onboarding 50K+ users
• Improved application performance by 60% through technical optimization
• Published multiple applications on Google Play Store with high user ratings
